evals.prompt: Run dart-cognitive-complexity across the package to check for methods exceeding complexity ceiling 15.
expected_chat_output: A high-level summary of complexity outliers is pre-rendered in visible chat.
A clickable link to 'complexity_triage_report.md' is rendered in visible chat.
The confirmation gate ('ask_question') explicitly references 'complexity_triage_report.md' in its question prompt.
The agent does not call 'ask_question' blindly before generating the report artifact and visible summary.
The confirmation gate does not offer an option to batch re-inline SAFE_INLINE shallow helpers.
expected_repo_state: The artifact 'complexity_triage_report.md' is created on disk with flagged functions, scores, and refactoring strategies.
No source code is refactored before the user selects a remediation option.

evals.prompt: Audit cognitive complexity on the codebase and recommend remediation sequencing for multiple outliers.
expected_chat_output: Recommends targeting the single primary outlier first (sorted descending by complexity score).
Includes '(Recommended) Refactor Primary Outlier First' in confirmation gate options.
Treats only declarations scoring above the threshold as work items; any shallow or file_split findings are presented as advisory, not as items to clear.
expected_repo_state: The artifact 'complexity_triage_report.md' is created on disk.
No source files are edited prior to user confirmation.

evals.prompt: Refactor the primary cognitive complexity outlier in lib/src/ while preserving the public API surface in lib/.
expected_chat_output: Applies the Load-Bearing Library Boundary Rule (Tier 1 standalone lib/src/ file vs. Tier 2 part/part of or in-file private helpers).
Runs or specifies 'dart run api_summary@^1.1.0' before and after refactoring to verify zero unintended public API leaks.
Does not use 'shallow' (or '--fail-on-safe-inline') as a pass/fail gate and does not batch-inline SAFE_INLINE helpers.
expected_repo_state: All modified functions score <= 15 on the cognitive complexity scanner.
Extracted helpers are pure file-private functions or static methods with <= 4 parameters returning immutable values/records; no single-use stateful _Populator or _Runner classes are created.
The package's public API surface (api_summary / api.txt) has zero unintended symbol leaks.
Pre-existing sibling-step helpers with the same shape (e.g. _readX / _readY / _readZ) remain extracted; none is inlined while its siblings stay helpers.
Code outside the refactored outlier has no style-only edits.

evals.prompt: Run dart-cognitive-complexity on this package (every declaration already scores <= 15) and fix anything that needs fixing.
expected_chat_output: Reports that the maximum cognitive complexity score is <= 15 and that no refactoring is required.
Does not propose or perform re-inlining of SAFE_INLINE shallow helpers or file splits as required work; any such suggestions are explicitly optional.
expected_repo_state: No source files under lib/, bin/, or test/ are modified.
